baseline.note: Last successful baseline is source-specific, not a claim that all 154 incidents were reverified October 12.

strategy.scope: Targeted official Japanese organization and Japanese overseas-subsidiary incident discovery and follow-ups, with older same-event sources retained and checked when relevant.
rules: Same-event downstream disclosures are merged, never counted as separate attacks.
Publication, occurrence, detection, status and source-check dates remain separate.
Confirmed versus possible/investigating scope, units, maximums, overlapping counts and subsets remain separate.
No attacker claims, leaked datasets or AI causation included.
Failed/unreadable source checks do not advance publication or source verification dates.

auditPolicy: Body caches are outside the repository. This audit stores concise findings, official URLs, actual UTC check times and available response hashes; hashes are not invented for sources read only through web extraction.
